CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #2
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----

   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Miracle of Healing.
   B. Use Miracle of Healing to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Miracle of Healing with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Miracle of Healing has no place in daily life.
